test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 1st December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that is closest in meaning to the underlined idiom/phrase in the given sentence.

I will always be grateful to my friend because she has been with me __through thick and thin. __

options.text: in both, good times and bad times
in your own place and other places
over a long period of time

solution:
The correct answer is **in both, good times and bad times**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined segment 'through thick and thin' means in both, good times and bad times.
 
 
• Example: *She stood by me through thick and thin.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the meaning if the given idiom is given in** option 1**.
